chapterInfo.content:
17
Yuda bɔne ne n’asotwe
1Yuda bɔne no, wɔde dadeɛ twerɛdua ne hyerɛmmoɔ ano na atwerɛ, wɔakurukyire no wɔn akoma apono so ne wɔn afɔrebukyia mmɛn so, 2berɛ a wɔn mma kae wɔn afɔrebukyia ne wɔn Asera nnua, dua frɔmfrɔm ne nkokoɔ sorɔnsorɔn soɔ no. 3Me bepɔ ne ɛho asase, mede w’ahodeɛ ne w’akoradeɛ nyinaa bɛma na wɔafom, ne wo sorɔnsorɔmmea no nso, w’asase yi nyinaa so bɔne nti. 4#Yer 15.14 Na wobɛgya w’agyapadeɛ a mede memaa woɔ no ato hɔ, na mɛma woasom w’atamfo, asase a wonnim soɔ so, ɛfiri sɛ moasɔ m’abufuo mu gya a ɛbɛdɛre daa.
5 # Dwom 118.8; 146.3 Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie:
Wɔadome onii ko a ɔde ne ho to onipa soɔ,
na ɔde honam yɛ ne basa,
na n’akoma atwe afiri AWURADE ho.
6 # Yer 48.6 Ɔte sɛ dua a ɛsi anwea pradada so,
na ɔrenhunu sɛ papa reba,
na ɔbɛtena ɛserɛ so nkyɛkyerɛ so, ne nkyene asase a obiara nte soɔ so.
7 # Dwom 146.5 Nhyira ne onii ko a ɔde ne ho to AWURADE soɔ,
na AWURADE yɛ n’anidasoɔ.
8 # Dwom 1.3 Na ɔbɛyɛ sɛ dua a wɔatɛ no nsunoa,
na ne nhini tentene kɔ asuo no ho.
Na sɛ ahuhuro ba a, ɛnyɛ no hu,
na ɛso ahahan bɛyɛ frɔmfrɔm,
na sukɔm afe mu nso,
ɛrempo, na ɛnnyae aba soɔ.
9Akoma wɔ hɔ yi, ɛyɛ nnaadaa sene adeɛ nyinaa
na ɛyɛ nsɛmmɔne pa ara,
hwan na ɔbɛnya mu ahunuyɛ?
10 # Dwom 7.9; Rom 2.6 Me, AWURADE, na mehwehwɛ adwene mu,
na mesɔ akoma mehwɛ,
na mɛma obiara sɛdeɛ n’akwan teɛ,
sɛdeɛ ne nneyɛɛ aba no teɛ.
11 # Dwom 39.6 Deɛ ɔrepɛ adeɛ anya, na ɔnnya no tenenee soɔ no,
te sɛ akokɔhwedeɛ a ɔbutu nkosua a ɛnyɛ ɔno ara na ɔtoeɛ soɔ,
ɔbɛbu ne nna mu fa agya,
na n’awieeɛ mu ɔbɛyɛ ɔkwasea.
12Animuonyam ahennwa a ɛsi sorɔnsorɔn soɔ firi teteete no,
ne yɛn kronkronbea,
13 # Yer 2.13 AWURADE, Israel anidasoɔ,
wɔn a wɔgya woɔ nyinaa ani bɛwuwu;
wɔn a wɔsane firi m’akyire no, wɔbɛtwerɛ wɔn din, asase so,
ɛfiri sɛ wɔagya nkwa asutire AWURADE.
14AWURADE, sa me yadeɛ na menya ahoɔden;
gye me, na manya nkwa;
na wone m’ayeyie.
15 # Yes 5.19 Hwɛ, wɔn deɛ, wɔka kyerɛ me sɛ:
Ɛhe na AWURADE asɛm no wɔ?
Ma no mmra ɛ!
16Nso me deɛ, menhyɛɛ wo sɛ ma bɔne mmra,
na menhwɛɛ mmusuo da no kwan,
wo ara wonim.
Deɛ ɛfiri m’anomu baeɛ no,
ɛda w’anim hɔ.
17Nyɛ me deɛ oyi me hu,
me dwanekɔbea ne wo, ɛda bɔne mu.
18Ma m’ataafoɔ ani nwuwu, na me deɛ,
mma m’ani nnwu;
wɔn deɛ, ma wɔn akoma ntu,
na me deɛ, mma m’akoma nntu;
fa da bɔne no bra wɔn so,
fa obubuo mmɔho bubu wɔn.
Homedadie ho afotuo
19Sɛ AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me nie: Kɔ kɔgyina ɔmanfoɔ ponkɛseɛ a Yuda ahemfo di mu ahyemfire no mu ne Yerusalem aponkɛseɛ nyinaa mu, 20na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Montie AWURADE asɛm, Yuda ahemfo ne Yuda man nyinaa ne Yerusalemfoɔ a mofa apono yi mu ba mu nyinaa! 21Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Monhwɛ mo kra so yie, na monnsoa adesoa biara homeda mmfa mmfa Yerusalem apono mu mmma mu; 22#Yes 56.2; 58.13 na monnsoa adesoa biara nso mmfiri mo afie mu mmfiri adi homeda, na monnyɛ adwuma biara; na monni homeda no kronkron, sɛdeɛ mehyɛɛ mo agyanom no. 23#Yer 11.8 Nanso wɔantie, na wɔammrɛ wɔn aso ase, na wɔsenee wɔn kɔn kyenkyirenn, deɛ ɛbɛyɛ na wɔantie na wɔampene atenetene.
24Na ɛbɛba sɛ, AWURADE asɛm nie, sɛ motie me, na momfa adesoa biara mfa kuro yi apono mu mma mu homeda, na modi homeda no kronkron, nyɛ emu adwuma biara a, 25ɛnneɛ ahemfo ne asafohene a wɔbɛtena Dawid adwa soɔ bɛtena nteaseɛnam mu ne apɔnkɔ so, wɔne wɔn asafohene, Yuda mmarima ne Yerusalemfoɔ, wɔbɛfa kuro yi apono mu aba mu. Na nnipa bɛtena kuro yi mu daa. 26Na wɔbɛfiri Yuda nkuro mu, ne deɛ ɛwowɔ Yerusalem ho, ne Benyamin asase soɔ ne mmepɔ ase ne mmepɔ so, ne Negeb aba de ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne okum afɔdeɛ ne aduane ayɛyɛdeɛ ne ohwamfufuo aba, na wɔde ayeyie afɔdeɛ aba AWURADE fie. 27Nanso sɛ moantie me, anni homeda no kronkron na, mosoa adesoa bi fa Yerusalem apono mu homeda a, ɛnneɛ mɛsɔ n’apono mu gya, na ahye Yerusalem aban afɛfɛ no, na wɔrennum.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
